description: Search editing techniques by the result you want or by name. Returns about 10 candidates with short descriptions, for you to choose from. Words are matched all together first, then any of them. Forms of one technique, such as Kaleidoscope and Kaleidoscope Transition, come as one result with the others under variants; ask for a transition by saying so. When techniques that are often mixed up come back together, each has pick_when.

offset.description: Skip this many results to see the next page

query.description: What the result should look or sound like, or the name of a technique

name: search_techniques
